messages:
mike: heads-up: I'm sketching a proposal for a "late-backfill" path for enrichment when downstream tags arrive much later than ingest TTL. goal: avoid losing billing attribution without blowing up normal ingest. high-level idea below.
olive: sounds necessary. we see spikes of late attributions from mobile sdk after retries. curious how we avoid duplicates in billing.
yara: we should separate two concerns: (1) immediate attribution for real-time dashboards, (2) authoritative billing. late-backfill should only patch authoritative store, not overwrite near-realtime aggregates.
sam: proposed flow: edge emits slim envelope -> ingest decides keep/drop and writes tombstone (TTL default 2h). Enrichment pipeline does async attribute joins within TTL. If we get additional attribution events after TTL, route them to a "backfill queue" that writes authoritative billing rows but marks them as backfilled. Downstream analytics can reconcile by ignoring backfilled rows for real-time views.
mike: example envelope we expect from edge: ```{ env_id: "uuid", trace_hash: "sha1", route: "/v1/submit", minimal_keys: ["tenant_id_hash"], client_attempt: 2 }```
olive: how do we trigger backfill? an external service may call an API with env_id + extra_attrs, or we may consume a late-event kafka topic.
yara: agree, both. provide POST /ingest/backfill { env_id, attrs } with auth for services, and a consumer on topic "late-enrich". backfill worker must do idempotent upsert keyed on env_id + attr_version.
sam: dedupe plan: maintain a small index of processed backfill versions per env_id (only for backfill path), TTL'd for 7 days. backfill writes are labelled backfill=true in billing table. reconciliation job merges provisional+backfill into authoritative billing nightly.
mike: cost/ops: backfill index at 7d ~ small (depends on error rates). need alerting when backfill rate spikes: ingest.backfill.rate and ingest.backfill.fail_rate.
ops-bot: ticket created: INF-6120 "late-backfill enrichment path" -> tasks: backfill API, consumer, idempotent writer, reconcile job, dashboards.
olive: privacy note: backfilled attrs may contain PII in some customers. restrict which services can call backfill API and ensure logs redact PII.
yara: decision: implement late-backfill as a paid/opt-in capability initially, with strict RBAC and audit logs. default behavior remains TTL tombstone + drop. run 2-week pilot with mobile traffic. owners: mike->backfill API, sam->consumer + dedupe index, olive->privacy + RBAC. will sync Thursday 11am to review pilot metrics. :raised_hands:
